mintAuthority.summary: DLLR's current Mynt aggregator mints against deposited bAssets, but the token-owning 48-hour Timelock can replace the authorized MassetManager with any nonzero address, which can mint without a deposit or numeric cap. D14 is unbounded with continuous basket reconciliation. GovernorAlpha's nonzero guardian can change the Timelock admin without token voting, so the sole-governor gate fails.

controls.label: Mynt MassetManager (1:1 aggregator mint)
controls.capDescription: Mints DLLR 1:1 only against deposited accepted bAssets (ZUSD, DOC); supply is bounded by deposited underlying stablecoins, not a fresh CDP.
controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 8935202, owner() on MassetManager proxy 0x5f777270 returned Timelock 0x967c84b731679e36a344002b8e3ce50620a7f69f. EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned ProxyAdmin 0x466e023ddd08b53385b4763b883ab63820c123df, whose owner() also returned the same Timelock. The Timelock's delay (storage slot 2) = 0x2a300 = 172800 seconds (48 hours). The Timelock's admin() = GovernorAlpha 0x6496df39d000478a7a7352c01e0e713835051ccd, whose timelock() = Timelock 0x967c84. This confirms a full DAO governance chain: SOV-token GovernorAlpha → 48-hour Timelock → MassetManager.

controls.label: Sovryn GovernorAlpha + 48h Timelock (basket governance)
controls.evidence: GovernorAlpha 0x6496df controls the 48-hour Timelock 0x967c84 that owns the MassetManager and its ProxyAdmin. GovernorAlpha.timelock() returns 0x967c84. SOV stakers vote to authorize changes via GovernorAlpha proposals queued through the Timelock.
controls.capDescription: The Timelock owns DLLR and can call setMassetManagerProxy to authorize any nonzero minter; DLLR.mint checks only that minter, not collateral or a supply cap. Basket admission and upgrades are separate powers.

review.evidence: At Rootstock block 8935202: MassetManager proxy 0x5f777270 owner() = Timelock 0x967c84b7; EIP-1967 proxy-admin 0x466e023d owner() = same Timelock. Timelock delay slot = 0x2a300 (48 h). Timelock admin() = GovernorAlpha 0x6496df39; GovernorAlpha timelock() = 0x967c84b7 (confirmed circular, correct). Full DAO governance chain verified on-chain. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: SOV governance can change basket capacity or mint logic only through the enforced 48-hour Timelock, live Rootstock basket balances continuously cover 1:1 issuance, and no independent attestor or prudential supervisor is evidenced. D14/D29 sweep 2026-10-03 supersedes the historical bounded classification: at Rootstock block 9293830 (hash 0x8f77258c9cfba3d0da535f26b47e1de9060951f7656ba25946725fdc3b160a41), DLLR.owner() is Timelock 0x967c84b731679e36a344002b8e3ce50620a7f69f. Verified DLLR.setMassetManagerProxy(address) admits any nonzero address; mint(address,uint256) checks only the configured minter, with no deposit or cap check. Read-only setter calls from Timelock and raw mint calls from the current manager succeed. This establishes unbounded minter authorization independently of basket admission or upgrades. Current aggregator issuance remains continuously deposit-accounted. D29 fails G1: GovernorAlpha.guardian() is 0x924f5ad34698fd20c90fe5d5a8a0abd3b42dc711, and verified __queueSetTimelockPendingAdmin/__executeSetTimelockPendingAdmin let it change Timelock admin without token voting. delay()=172800 and staking votes use past-block checkpoints, but neither removes that root. Complete recursive guardian/admin executionScope closure is not certified; no governed qualification is asserted. Fallback is unbounded-reconciled.
